snippet.title: Sonic Adventure Advanced SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Small trailer of the Demo 01 of Sonic Adventure Advanced, which will be at this year's SAGE 2025.  Look forward to playing this and more: http://sagexpo.org

This is a fan made game.  SEGA and SONIC TEAM has no affiliation with this project.  I do not own the rights to any of the characters or music featured in this project.
